How a booking works

You deal with us. We handle the rest.

You deal with Usafiri Pro for the whole booking, from your inquiry to the end of your journey.

  1. Tell us the trip

    Where, when, how many people and what you need.

  2. Your quote is calculated

    Our system automatically calculates the price from your trip details.

  3. You receive your quotation

    A clear quotation for your trip is sent to you before you confirm.

  4. We coordinate payment

    Payment, pickup details and trip arrangements are organised for you.

  5. We stay in touch

    We manage communication before and during the journey.
